text:
sam: Heads up — after rolling the new router variant to 10% traffic at 12:11 UTC we're seeing a sustained spike in 5xxs on /infer. inference.errors.request_5xx jumped from ~0.02% to ~1.1% in the last 5m. Tried opening the inference dashboard panel but got a 404 (https://grafana.company/d/inf).

incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 detected — High error rate in inference namespace. Pager: mike_oncall. Link: <https://incidents.company/1841234567>

mike_oncall: I'm on it. Paging in. Can someone confirm customer impact and whether a rollback or a feature-flag kill is possible? @dana_prodops @jordan_sre

jordan_sre: Quick check — the new router isn't exporting route_response_code to Prometheus. Scrape target is up but metric absent, so our oncall dashboards are blank for the right signal. That explains the 404 panel too (it references the missing metric).

rita_eng: We rolled out ff/new-routing to 10% via rollout service (rollout id r-8372). We can flip it back to 0%. Rollout was triggered at 12:11 UTC from the deploy console.

dana_prodops: Trying to toggle kill-switch via Flags API in us-west1... hitting 504 from flags-service. UI calls also time out. Attempting fallback.

mike_oncall: Any customer reports? Severity?

sam: A few customers reported user-facing errors (Sentry ID: 0x9f3a). Some EU frontends show timeouts. Looks like certain model variant combos trigger the 5xx.

deploy-bot: deploy r-8372 -> router-service rollout to 10% completed (initial canary SUCCESS).

jordan_sre: Also: several alert groups were muted earlier for noisy infra alerts; we had no dedicated alert on inference.errors.rate — only app-high-latency and infra-unhealthy, which were noisy and suppressed. So early signal didn't page properly. Observability gap.

mike_oncall: Action items (short):
1) Try to pause the rollout / flip flag off.
2) If flags API unreachable, rollback the deploy.
3) Assess customer impact and regions affected.
4) Re-enable missing metric export and add a temp dashboard panel.
5) Postmortem and remediation.

rita_eng: Attempting rollback from deploy console now. Rollback command shows:```bash
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/router-service --to-revision=183
```
I'll run as soon as Dana confirms flag path is down.

dana_prodops: Flags UI is down. Doing manual DB patch as emergency fallback (will record audit). Patch:```sql
UPDATE feature_flags SET state='off', updated_by='dana_prodops', note='emergency kill 1841234567' WHERE key='ff/new-routing';
```
Applying now. Audit id: audit-1293.

mike_oncall: Careful — record exact audit and broadcast to compliance. Which region did you patch?

dana_prodops: Global config is centralized; change propagated via config-puller. Patching from us-west1 console, propagation expected in ~30s.

incident-bot: FLAG_CHANGED ff/new-routing -> OFF by dana_prodops (audit-1293)

sam: Errors dropping to baseline in us-east, EU still elevated. Looks like partial kill worked for some traffic buckets.

jordan_sre: Root cause analysis (quick): the new router sets Content-Type header as application/octet-stream for large payloads, causing model-server to return 502 for some variants. We'll prepare hotfix to normalize header. Also, metrics emission gap: router-exporter didn't include the route_response_code label for v2 bundle — missing instrumentation in the rolled image.

rita_eng: I'll cut a small patch to normalize headers and redeploy a 5% canary to validate fix.

mike_oncall: We still need a clear SLO picture. Right now p99 latency increased and we saw SLO burn, but alerts got noisy and some mute rules hid the early signal. We must map SLO -> concrete metrics used by alerts.

dana_prodops: Noted for postmortem: immediate mitigations: create a temporary Grafana panel with query `sum(rate(inference.errors.request_5xx[1m])) by (region)` and add it to the incident runbook; add a runbook link to the oncall page; add DB fallback kill-switch documented; move flags-service to multi-region.

sam: I'm logging full customer list and Sentry samples in the incident tracker (incident-1841234567). We'll attach timelines.

mike_oncall: Handing off for long-tail follow-up — @jess_oncall will take ownership at 23:00 UTC for next shift. Please make sure runbook/docs include the temporary panel and the emergency flag DB steps.

jess_oncall: on it — will assemble timeline, capture exact alert mutation that caused the suppression, and draft RCA outline.

incident-bot: Incident 1841234567 status -> mitigated (partial). Please continue updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks all. Leaving thread open until EU returns to baseline. :wave:
